cases.question: 2026年第二季度共有多少笔已支付订单，销售额合计多少元？按4月1日含至7月1日不含统计。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0,2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.order_date>=? AND o.order_date<?

cases.question: 按全部订单数为分母，已取消订单占比是多少？百分数保留两位小数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*),2) AS cancelled_percent FROM orders

cases.question: 仅看华东地区2026年第二季度，按商品类别统计已支付销售额（元），金额降序，金额相同时类别名称升序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0,2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.region=? AND o.order_date>=? AND o.order_date<? GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sales_yuan DESC,p.category ASC

cases.question: 2026年第二季度哪些日期的已支付销售额最高？列出前三天的日期和金额（元），金额相同时按日期升序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_date,ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0,2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.order_date>=? AND o.order_date<? GROUP BY o.order_date ORDER BY sales_yuan DESC,o.order_date ASC LIMIT 3

cases.question: 按已支付订单中的商品件数排行，列出销量前三名的商品编号、名称和件数；件数相同时按商品编号升序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.product_id,p.product_name,SUM(i.quantity) AS quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY p.product_id,p.product_name ORDER BY quantity DESC,p.product_id ASC LIMIT 3

cases.question: 有多少笔已支付订单至少有2条订单明细？按订单数统计。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY o.order_id HAVING COUNT(i.item_id)>=2) AS selected_orders

cases.question: 按地区列出全部订单数、取消订单数和取消率，取消率以该地区全部订单数为分母并保留两位百分数，按地区名称升序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT region,COUNT(*) AS order_count,SUM(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_count,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*),2) AS cancelled_percent FROM orders GROUP BY region ORDER BY region ASC

cases.question: 哪一笔已支付订单的明细金额最高？返回订单号和金额（元）；金额相同时按订单号升序只取第一笔。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_id,ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0,2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY sales_yuan DESC,o.order_id ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 哪一笔已支付订单的明细金额最低？必须包含零金额订单，返回订单号和金额（元）；并列时按订单号升序只取第一笔。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_id,ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0,2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY sales_yuan ASC,o.order_id ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 已支付订单中，有多少笔订单的明细金额合计不少于10000元？请先按订单汇总，再统计订单数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY o.order_id HAVING SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)>=?) AS selected_orders

cases.question: 仅统计已支付订单，商品P001按购买数量加权的平均实际成交单价是多少元？用金额合计除以件数合计，保留两位小数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0/SUM(i.quantity),2) AS weighted_unit_price_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND i.product_id=?

cases.question: 华北地区的已支付销售额占全部已支付销售额的百分之多少？分母使用所有地区的已支付销售额，百分数保留两位小数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.region='华北' THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END)*100.0/SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents),2) AS share_percent FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid'

cases.question: 按商品类别分别列出2026年第一季度、第二季度已支付销售额（元）及第二季度相对第一季度的增长率，第一季度为基期，百分数保留两位，按类别名称升序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.category,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date<'2026-04-01' THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END)/100.0,2) AS q1_yuan,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date>='2026-04-01' THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END)/100.0,2) AS q2_yuan,ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date>='2026-04-01' THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date<'2026-04-01' THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END))*100.0/SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date<'2026-04-01' THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END),2) AS growth_percent FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.order_date>=? AND o.order_date<? GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category ASC

cases.question: 按月份统计2026年1月至6月的已支付订单笔数，按月份升序，并绘制柱状图。纵轴使用订单笔数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',order_date) AS month,COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status='paid' AND order_date>=? AND order_date<? GROUP BY month ORDER BY month ASC

cases.question: 查询订单V2O9999的订单状态。如果没有找到该订单，请明确说明不存在，不要将其当作一笔零金额订单。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT order_id,status FROM orders WHERE order_id=?
review_points: 结果为空时说明没有找到该订单。
不得编造状态，或将不存在描述为已存在且金额为零。

cases.question: 请统计某个月的已支付订单数量，但我还没确定年份和月份。先向我询问这两个条件，不要自行选择时间范围。
review_points: 明确询问缺失条件，不自行选择范围。
不得将全库统计或猜测的范围当成所请求结果。

cases.question: 2026年7月已支付销售额相比6月增长了百分之多少？没有订单的月份金额按0计算，以6月为基期，百分数保留两位。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date)=? THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END)/100.0,2) AS base_yuan,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date)=? THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END)/100.0,2) AS current_yuan,ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date)=? THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date)=? THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END))*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date)=? THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS growth_percent FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.order_date>=? AND o.order_date<?

cases.question: 2026年1月已支付销售额相比2025年12月的增长率是多少？没有订单的月份金额按0，若基期金额为0，请说明无法按该公式计算，不要给出百分比。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date)=? THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END)/100.0,2) AS base_yuan,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date)=? THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END)/100.0,2) AS current_yuan,ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date)=? THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date)=? THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END))*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date)=? THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS growth_percent FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.order_date>=? AND o.order_date<?
review_points: 给出或说明基期为0，增长率无法按该公式计算。
不得将零基期增长率回答为0%、100%或无穷大。

cases.question: 2026年第二季度，按地区和商品类别两个维度统计已支付销售额（元），按地区名称升序、类别名称升序排列。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.region,p.category,ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0,2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.order_date>=? AND o.order_date<? GROUP BY o.region,p.category ORDER BY o.region ASC,p.category ASC
